build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: data: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Native desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness
bundle.longDescription: oardsh launches dsh web as a native desktop app: it starts the local DeepSeek Harness server and loads the UI in a desktop window.
